title: Solution optical behavior of two organoboron dyes
difficulty_reasons: Corresponding excited states must be identified across two intact dye structures and two solvents.
Calculated vertical transitions and measured bands require a defined comparison and explicit model limitations.

data.description: Two complete dye identities, supplied chloroform/methanol absorption observations and measurement conditions.

required_deliverables.description: Structured model, execution, quantitative evidence and claim records with raw artifact links.
Scientific answer, evidence, revisions, uncertainty and scope.
